simple.meaning: דָּגָה (dâgâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to spawn , i.e. become numerous.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 48:16. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּגָה (H1711) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דָּגָה (dâgâh) / H1711 is traced through Genesis 48:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.
